@@ -149,3 +149,16 @@ Sources: `dev_lab/_work/summon_exp_20261103/EXP_DAT_DESIGN_20261103.md` (runtime
 [F§64.2・1671–1678行](research/recovered/findings/PEER_SCRIPT01_FINDINGS_20261011.md?plain=1#L1671-L1678)は「実装した関数」の `unit_strength_587cc0` を説明し、fv_*係数の各積をchopしてdef+0x1C4へ格納すると記述する。[F§75・2702–2708行](research/recovered/findings/PEER_SCRIPT01_FINDINGS_20261011.md?plain=1#L2702-L2708)にも引数1の返値を使う評価式がある。固定保存版FのSHA256は `6c61b104076363710e09535c6db62daedbe0f0ee159a6ce3240aceb4f417d2d8`。これは参照すべき実装・静的対応の著者報告として残す。
 
 ただし、この実装説明の引用箇所は原作calleeの完全な命令列・内部store位置を提示していない。節固有の観測日時も不明で、文書題名の日付だけでT011との新旧を決めない。「内部書込未証明」はT011§17の限定取得範囲に対する記録であり、すべての研究に格納報告が存在しないという主張ではない。Fのstrengthという命名・式・格納と、原作callee/callerの帰属・完全な返値・副作用は未照合。今回、その報告を新しいwrite関係や確定用途へ自動採用せず、保留された後半も取得しない。
+
+## 同じnode+0x28でも保存形式を分ける
+
+保存済み[EXP save/cache境界の証拠票](research/recovered/json_exp_exe1/reports/14_EXP_SAVE_TREE_BOUNDARY_EVIDENCE_20261021.json)26–29/50–53/74–78行（SHA256 `9622a342f6b8ca7b023abc9b225b5020e952f8868fb253240bf8ac795b1052e4`）は、2つの木の保存形式を明示的に分けている。
+
+| 研究用の部分レイアウト | +0x28の役割 | 既存関数との関係 |
+|---|---|---|
+| [SaveUnitDataTreeNode](reference/structs/SaveUnitDataTreeNode.md) | UnitDataへのポインタを格納 | 0x460000がowner+0x300の木のノードからポインタ値を読む |
+| [SummonRecordCacheNode](reference/structs/SummonRecordCacheNode.md) | 埋め込み記録の先頭。欄の宣言型はunknown | 0x577260がowner+0x1E4B4のcacheから見つけた記録のアドレスを返す |
+
+同じ数値のオフセットを型同一性・同じ間接参照段数の証明にしない。cacheの468Bという大きさは[別の構造導出](research/recovered/json_exp_exe1/reports/19_EXP_STRING_CACHE_ABI_EVIDENCE_20261021.json)358–369行（SHA256 `8440b0057d6983d291a151217af7f5a60839d14c9e1f4cd7e9acaf97f1aebb6e`）の限定された著者報告であり、完全なC++宣言型や実行時動作を確定しない。keyやowner全体の型・別場面の同一性は追加採録していない。
+
+元報告の静的・未実行・VERIFYの区分を保つ。全save経路が同じwriterを使うこと、召喚EXPがsave以前に移されないこと、全間接CALLを網羅したことは証明していない。正式レイアウトへの部分採録と、実機確認・ゲーム結果の保証を分ける。

+# TXT・CSV・JSONLの役割確認とメモリの採録
+
+403候補から118出典を受け入れ、[TXT役割確認1](../text_roles1/README.md)・[TXT役割確認2](../text_roles2/README.md)・[所在目録と行形式記録](../other_records1/README.md)を共通検索へ接続した。70出典は元バイト完全一致、40出典はUTF16LE BOMからUTF8への損失のない完全版、8出典は個人パスのみ伏せた完全版。元SHA・保存先SHA・編集区間/不変区間・元形式への再符号化一致を親でも照合した。ファイル保存の件数を新規の関数発見や実機成功の数にしない。
+
+285候補は、短いheader/schema・必要な形式統計により、未解釈の単独native命令/擬似C/window集合、元MIDIの全event輸出、具体的な既存保留の内容、または帰属未解決のjump-site表と判断し、全文・抜粋・代替再構成を保存せず[識別・確認範囲・理由](DEFERRED_AT_INTAKE.tsv)を残した。全文意味レビューや個人情報不在確認を行ったとの主張ではない。新しい取得拒否とは扱わない。既存の2件はexact path/SHAの保留を照合して再読していない。
+
+受理資料は語句・RTTI・xref・定数・推定callbackの索引、短い著者の解析、資産の所在/件数/hash目録、継承の選別事例、選別された状態/counter/eventの行形式記録。元ゲームの音声・アーカイブ・設定ファイル自体やリンク先のraw captureを取得したものではない。受理本文は全文または全行形式ノードと異なる記述/値域を確認し、個別票に方法を分けた。空欄・既存mojibake・誤decode・None・callback_guess・歴史的な留保や訂正を勝手に修復/確定していない。静的・推定・合成検査・実機の区分を維持する。
+
+[メモリ採録](MEMORY_BINDINGS.tsv)では既存の2関数と2つのnode+0x28を結んだ。[保存木ノード](../../../reference/structs/SaveUnitDataTreeNode.md)はUnitDataポインタを格納し、[召喚記録cacheノード](../../../reference/structs/SummonRecordCacheNode.md)は埋め込み記録の先頭を置く。前者は0x460000のread、後者は0x577260が返すアドレスとして元の著者報告に結ぶ。共通オフセットから型同一性・同じ間接参照段数を推定しない。cacheの宣言型はunknown、468Bは別証拠票の限定構造導出にとどめる。完全ABI・全save経路・EXP事前転送の有無・実行時到達性は未確認。
+
+新しい関数/型alias・実機試験・Golden/READYは増やしていない。原本は変更・削除せず、ゲーム/native/DB/リンク先を実行・追加取得していない。公開設定は非公開のまま。未回収の他形式やチャット・PR履歴まで完了したとは扱わない。

+T005 scenario generic-property / duplicate / control-block harvesting evidence
+Target: bundled Vahren.exe in 迫真戦記 0.67 CORE (read-only static analysis)
+
+[1] Current structure -> per-structure field table
+Structure dispatcher 0x504400 selects/creates the current named structure in RB tree global 0x8797DC.
+Existing structure path:
+  00504841 mov eax,[ebp+0x28]
+  00504844 mov [0x8797E0],eax
+Likewise 0x5049C0/0x5049C3 loads node payload +0x28 into 0x8797E0.
+New structure path allocates a table (0x462C70), stores it in 0x8797E0, wraps structure name with 0x510F40, then inserts into 0x8797DC via 0x463280.
+Therefore 0x8797E0 is the current structure's property/field table pointer.
+
+[2] Generic fallback property parser
+Main/body parse core looks up a token-specific callback. When registry lookup misses, it calls 0x505210:
+  0050BA24 cmp edi,[0x87A4FC]
+  0050BA2A je  0x50BA49
+  ... registered callback path ...
+  0050BA49 ...
+  0050BA5D call 0x505210
+Thus 0x505210 is the generic fallback assignment/property parser.
+
+[3] Generic field insertion is insert-if-absent
+Inside 0x505210:
+  005055AC mov edx,[0x8797E0]
+  005055B2 mov ecx,eax
+  005055B6 call 0x436680   ; create RB node/key wrapper
+  005055C1 push esi        ; current field table
+  005055C2 call 0x463280   ; RB insert helper
+0x463280 was independently reverse-engineered as insert-if-absent: existing key returns existing node and does not replace payload.
+Therefore duplicate generic properties within one structure are first-insertion-wins.
+
+[4] scenario `map` uses the generic path
+Exact target `map` string/xref inventory contains runtime/accessor consumers but no special-parser registration.
+Special parser registry global-string map resolves registered keys including if/rif/while/battle, text, skill, skill2, color, ray, home, multi, learn, activenum, weapon/weapon2, joint, friend_ex, member, merce, add2, next2, next3, just_next, monster, item, sound, castle_guard, friend/enemy/staff/offset/delskill/delskill2/voice_type, etc.; `map` is absent.
+Hence scenario map=... falls through 0x505210 and is inserted into current field table with first-insertion-wins semantics.
+
+[5] map inside runtime-false if is still structurally harvested
+`if/rif` parser callback 0x50A5E0 constructs ScriptIF parse nodes and manipulates the global parse-stack 0x87A518..0x87A51C. It does not swap or clear globals 0x8797DC/0x8797E0.
+Subsequent tokens in the brace body continue through the same main/body dispatcher; an unregistered `map` token therefore still reaches 0x505210 and inserts into the same current structure field table during parse time. Runtime condition evaluation occurs later and cannot suppress this parse-time side effect.
+
+Strict-target conclusions:
+- scenario `map` is a structural property even when textually placed inside an if/rif body.
+- duplicate scenario `map` assignments are first-wins at parse/property-table level.
+- Reimplementation must separate structural property harvesting from runtime VM control flow for generic assignments that mutate the structure field table.

+# T014 global API exact aux/default semantics
+調査日: 2026-10-07
+
+[CONFIRMED-TARGET]
+- gread handler: VA 0x4A5F53. global read core: VA 0x428010.
+- 0x428010 resets the default result record before file lookup: aux string empty, int32 value 0.
+- If global.sav is absent or the requested key is absent, the returned logical record therefore remains {aux="", value=0}.
+- If the key exists, 0x428010 copies mapped int32 (+0x1C) into the default result record and copies the mapped aux std::string into the result string.
+- gread always assigns the numeric value to argument 2. When argc>=3, the handler also assigns the returned aux string to argument 3.
+
+[CONFIRMED-TARGET]
+- gwrite handler: VA 0x4A60D1. global mutate/write core: VA 0x428710.
+- The handler initializes its local aux string to empty before checking argument count.
+- When argc>=3, argument 3 is evaluated as a string and copied into that local aux value.
+- Therefore gwrite(key,value) passes an empty aux string; gwrite(key,value,aux) passes the supplied aux.
+- Existing-key update path 0x428C40..0x428C58 overwrites BOTH mapped int32 (+0x1C) and mapped aux string.
+- Strict consequence: a 2-argument gwrite does not preserve a previously stored aux string; it clears aux to empty while updating the numeric value.
+
+[HAKUSEN CORPUS]
+- normalized 0.67 corpus: gread argc2 = 440, argc3 = 0.
+- gwrite argc2 = 441, argc3 = 22.
+- All observed 3-argument gwrite examples use the third string as a clear/mark PNG name, e.g. gwrite(mark@po14,1,clearsww.png).
+
+[EVIDENCE]

Original-asset keywords and selected short witnesses are not whole game assets or configuration exports.

Existing holds remain binding; no linked targets or unselected native/game/script/log/code/DB/archive material was fetched.

Privacy offsets are zero-based half-open UTF-8 byte offsets; token hashes and unchanged prefix/inter-span/suffix gaps are recorded without exposing removed profile tokens. Exact bytes/BOM/newlines are otherwise preserved; no normalization or reserialization is performed.

+# T006 win() battle-exit semantics
+調査日: 2026-10-07
+
+[CONFIRMED-TARGET]
+- command opcode5 `win` handler is VA 0x4A174A and returns AL=1 (Yield).
+- handler first calls 0x52BFF0 on engine+0x1E8630, then calls 0x493630 with engine execution/battle state.
+- 0x493630 performs battle teardown: clears engine+0x1EEC44 (battle-active), +0x1EEC48, +0x1EED40/+0x1EED42, clears battleEvent active-root list at +0x1EEDB8, and performs scene/UI cleanup/rebuild paths.
+- when current executionMode is 2, 0x493630 invokes teardown virtuals on engine+0x1E8630/+0x1E8634/+0x1E8638 before clearing battle state.
+- dispatcher zeroes EDI before opcode dispatch; win passes this fixed 0 as the second stack argument to 0x493630.
+- natural battle finish caller 0x40E2B9 passes `(resultCode==1)` as the same argument. 0x493630 tests it at 0x494858 and selects two large post-battle branches (0 -> 0x494866, nonzero -> 0x494F8E).
+- therefore strict win semantics are battle exit/teardown with fixed resultFlag=0 + Yield. Human side meaning of resultFlag is not yet named.
+
+[HAKUSEN CORPUS]
+- normalized 0.67 corpus contains 32 `win()` calls.
+- the same command is used after both player-victory and player-defeat/enemy-victory dialogue in RTS scripts.
+- outcome-specific flags/dialogue are set by surrounding script before `win()`; the command itself is shared.
+
+[WIKI CROSSCHECK]
+- current Vahren Wiki documents win() as leaving the battle scene; this matches target native teardown and corpus usage.
+
+[REIMPLEMENT]
+- strict engine should model `win()` as battle-scene teardown + fixed resultFlag=0 + VM Yield.
+- keep script-authored victory/defeat flags/dialogue separate from the native finish-core resultFlag; map resultFlag 0/1 to human side semantics only after T010 closes the post-battle branches.
+

+- exe/T006_WIN_PROBE.txt
